qc = QuantumCircuit(4, 4)
qc.h(0)
qc.rx(pi / 4, 0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.measure(0, 0)
qc.measure(1, 1)
qc.measure(2, 2)
qc.measure(3, 3)

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from numpy import pi
qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.rz(pi / 4, 0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure(0, 0)
qc.measure(1, 1)
